title: Inbound MKT Specialist
description:
About the job

Nos encontramos en búsqueda de un Inbound MKT Specialist,

¿Te apasiona convertir contenido, datos y estrategia digital en oportunidades reales de negocio?




En nuestra agencia de marketing experiencial estamos buscando a una persona que nos ayude a atraer, convertir y nutrir prospectos B2B, conectando nuestras estrategias de marketing con nuevas oportunidades comerciales.




¿Qué harás?




• Desarrollar, optimizar y descargar formularios, listas y materiales

• Gestionar email marketing, templates, etc.

• Administrar y optimizar bases de datos y CRM (Hubspot)

• Implementar y dar seguimiento a Lead Scoring, MQL y SQL.

• Analizar el funnel y proponer mejoras basadas en datos.

• Trabajar de manera cercana con Comercial, Diseño, Contenido y Paid Media.

✔️ Sea proactivo, organizado y con iniciativa.

✔️ Disfrute trabajar en equipo y en un ambiente dinámico.




📍 Zona: Naucalpan, Edo. Méx.

🏢 Modalidad: Híbrido

💼 Tipo de puesto: Por proyecto 3 meses




Si te interesa transformar estrategias digitales en oportunidades reales de negocio, ¡queremos conocerte!

title: Líder de Marketing - B2B SaaS
skills: Definir e implementar la estrategia de marketing (posicionamiento, generación de demanda, contenido, distribución multicanal) alineada a los objetivos comerciales de la compañía.
Liderar y desarrollar a un equipo de marketing ya en funciones, dándole dirección, prioridades claras y acompañamiento cercano.
Construir y mantener procesos de planeación (calendario editorial, pipeline de campañas, métricas de desempeño) donde hoy hay buen talento pero falta estructura.
Conectar el trabajo de marketing con el equipo comercial, asegurando que la generación de demanda se traduzca en pipeline real.
Tomar decisiones de inversión y priorización con recursos limitados, típico de una startup en escalamiento.
Reportar resultados y aprendizajes de forma directa a la dirección ejecutiva.
Experiencia liderando o co-liderando el área de Marketing en empresas B2B SaaS en etapa de startup o scaleup, idealmente en o para mercados de LATAM.
Perfil híbrido: capacidad estratégica, pero con comodidad operando "con las manos" cuando el equipo o el momento lo requiere — esto no es un rol de solo supervisión.
Experiencia liderando personas.
Pensamiento analítico: te sientes cómoda leyendo métricas de conversión, pipeline y desempeño de campañas para tomar decisiones, no solo para reportar.
Capacidad de trabajar en ambigüedad y estructuras que aún se están formando — no todo va a estar documentado el primer día.
Experiencia B2B en industrias adyacentes: proptech, retail tech, analítica de tráfico peatonal, o SaaS vendido a operadores de espacios físicos.
Experiencia trabajando con equipos 100% remotos y distribuidos en distintos países de LATAM.

description:
About the job

About Sezzle:

With a mission to financially empower the next generation, Sezzle is revolutionizing the shopping experience beyond payments, blending cutting-edge tech with seamless, interest-free installment plans that make shopping smarter and more accessible. We’re not just transforming payments; we’re redefining how people discover, interact with, and purchase the things they love while driving real impact on merchant sales through increased conversions and higher order values. As we continue to shape the future of fintech and retail, we’re building an innovative, dynamic team passionate about creating more than just a transaction but a truly unique shopping journey. If you’re excited about pushing boundaries in tech and delivering a game-changing experience for consumers and merchants alike, come join us at Sezzle and help create the future of shopping!

About the Role: 

We are seeking a talented and motivated Marketing Growth Communications Intern who is best in class with a high IQ plus a high EQ. This role presents an exciting opportunity to thrive in a dynamic, fast-paced environment within a rapidly growing team, with abundant prospects for career advancement.

As a Marketing Growth Communications Intern, you will play a critical support role with responsibility for preparing and executing the campaigns behind our consumer programs — subscriptions, giveaways, surveys, and lifecycle communications — that reach millions of shoppers. A core focus will be managing our CRM platform (Braze) across email, push, SMS, and in-app, building and QAing assets, managing compliance approvals, and reporting on performance. In addition to execution, you will help build content to support channel optimization, segmentation, and analytics across all channels. To achieve these goals, you will engage with varying members across the marketing department, as well as Design, Product and Compliance.

The primary aim for this role is to help create relevant, customized and personalized content for our Sezzle consumers, to maximize revenue and engagement. Over time you will move from executing campaigns to shaping them — proposing the audience, the timing, and the message.

What You'll Do:

Build and launch campaigns


Build marketing communications in our CRM platform (Braze) across email, push, SMS, and in-app
Build and QA landing pages and campaign assets, making sure everything renders correctly before it reaches a single shopper
Own the day-to-day asset production flow: build, quality assurance, approvals, deployment, and communication with internal and external stakeholders

Keep the operation running


Support day-to-day operations, keeping every marketing initiative up to date and on schedule
Maintain and organize campaign documentation — briefs, schedules, reports, and final assets
Identify potential risks early and come with a recommendation for how to mitigate them
Support the client and sales teams with in-app promotional setup and reporting


Measure and improve

Recommend how to optimize the next campaign based on what the last one showed
Test copy, creative, and timing, and help work out which version earns its place
Use AI tools (Claude and similar) to speed up research, first drafts, and reporting


What We Look For:

Skills & Competencies


Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English 
Attention to detail is a must. There are plenty of moving parts within this role
Experience copywriting short and engaging messages
Comfortable with numbers — you can look at a table of campaign results and say something useful about it
Basic creative design skills and knowledge of Figma
You get the most out of AI. Claude, ChatGPT, or similar are already part of how you work — research, copy, summaries — and you're constantly exploring what else they can handle

A strong bias for action


Educational & Professional Experience

Basic project management skills

Experience building email templates or landing pages is a plus
Any experience with email, push notifications, in-app messaging, eCommerce, or digital marketing is a plus
Demonstrated experience working with Claude or equivalent large language model tools is required; candidates must be comfortable leveraging AI to enhance productivity, research, and communication.


About You:


You have relentlessly high standards - many people may think your standards are unreasonably high. You are continually raising the bar and driving those around you to deliver great results. You make sure that defects do not get sent down the line and that problems are fixed so they stay fixed.
You’re not bound by convention - your success—and much of the fun—lies in developing new ways to do things

You earn trust - you listen attentively, speak candidly, and treat others respectfully.
You have backbone; disagree, then commit - you can respectfully challenge decisions when you disagree, even when doing so is uncomfortable or exhausting. You have conviction and are tenacious. You do not compromise for the sake of social cohesion. Once a decision is determined, you commit wholly.
You deliver results - you focus on the key inputs and deliver them with the right quality and in a timely fashion. Despite setbacks, you rise to the occasion and never settle.

About the job

Somos Reckitt

Hogar de las marcas más queridas y confiables de higiene, salud y nutrición. Nuestro propósito define nuestra razón de existir: proteger, curar y nutrir en una búsqueda implacable por un mundo limpio y sano. Somos un equipo global unido por este propósito. Únete a nuestra lucha para lograr que el acceso a higene de calidad, bienestar y nutrición sea un derecho y no un privilegio.

Marketing

Marketing está en el corazón de Reckitt. Nos enorgullece nuestra forma única de impulsar el crecimiento de algunas de las marcas de salud, higiene y nutrición más queridas y confiables del mundo.

Nuestro propósito y espíritu de lucha son lo que nos motivan a diseñar y ofrecer comunicaciones diferenciadas a lo largo de todo el recorrido del consumidor, permitiéndonos generar crecimiento en nuestras categorías y, al mismo tiempo, un impacto positivo en la sociedad.

Con amplios equipos de medios y marketing digital integrados en toda la organización, medimos tanto nuestro impacto en el negocio como nuestro impacto social. Nuestros equipos globales lideran la estrategia general de marca, la gestión y protección de las marcas, así como la cartera de innovación, trabajando en estrecha colaboración con el área de Investigación y Desarrollo (I+D).

Esto permite que nuestros equipos locales de marketing se enfoquen en alcanzar los objetivos regionales en conjunto con los equipos de Ventas. Gracias a la escala de nuestra comunidad global de más de 2,500 profesionales de marketing, y al respaldo de nuestra innovadora Marketing Academy, tendrás amplias oportunidades para desarrollarte profesionalmente, adquirir nuevas habilidades y avanzar en tu carrera.

Sobre el puesto

La principal responsabilidad del Especialista de Marketing Médico es apoyar al área de Profesional Marketing y al equipo de Ventas Médicas mediante la propuesta, coordinación e implementación de los programas de Educación Médica Continua (CME, por sus siglas en inglés: Eventos médicos, round tables, lectura tours, participación en congresos, reuniones AdHoc con médicos, farmacias, clientes, garantizando una implementación impecable, el cumplimiento regulatorio y el logro de los objetivos comerciales.

Tus responsabilidades


Implementar actividades de Educación Médica Continua (CME), coordinando de manera efectiva a todas las áreas de profesional marketing, marketing, procurement, medical affairs, regulatorio, stakeholders externos.
Gestionar integralmente los procesos administrativos de compra para cada proyecto, incluyendo elaboración de briefs, procesos de licitación, presentación de propuestas, contratos, órdenes de compra, documentación de cumplimiento y cierre administrativo de eventos.
Administrar el presupuesto coordinando cierres mensuales, proyecciones financieras y seguimiento semanal para garantizar una ejecución alineada al plan.
Asegurar el cumplimiento de todos los procesos regulatorios y de compliance asociados a las actividades bajo su responsabilidad.
Garantizar la correcta documentación de cierre de proyectos, incluyendo auditorías, reportes finales y archivos de soporte.
Elaborar y presentar reportes ejecutivos y comerciales para los diferentes stakeholders del negocio, proporcionando análisis de KPIs(Reach, Engagement, SOP, SOM) y recomendaciones relevantes para la toma de decisiones.


La experiencia que buscamos


Experiencia previa en compañías de salud, nutrición o industrias altamente reguladas (por ejemplo, farmacéutica o dispositivos médicos).
Organización y gestión de eventos presenciales y virtuales.
Conocimiento del Canal Médico y sus principales actores.
Coordinación y supervisión de agencias externas y proveedores.


Las habilidades para el éxito


Ejecución de eventos y programas educativos.
Liderazgo e influencia transversal.
Administración y control de presupuestos.
Análisis e interpretación de información y datos.
Gestión de proyectos.


Lo que ofrecemos

En Reckitt ofrecemos una cultura inclusiva y de apoyo donde los empleados pueden prosperar profesional y personalmente. Nuestros beneficios pueden incluir compensación competitiva, bonos basados en desempeño y planes accionarios, junto con un apoyo integral de salud y bienestar, como cobertura médica, seguro de vida y un Programa de Asistencia para Empleados.

Podemos proporcionar esquemas de trabajo flexible e híbrido, generosas licencias parentales y oportunidades de crecimiento profesional mediante capacitación, experiencia práctica y proyectos. Además, los empleados disfrutan beneficios como planes de retiro, descuentos y apoyo de reubicación, todo diseñado para ayudarte a construir una vida equilibrada y gratificante.

Equidad

Estamos comprometidos con el acceso equitativo a oportunidades en todas las áreas de empleo y negocio, sin importar características personales o percibidas como (entre otras): edad, discapacidad, condición médica, color, etnicidad, raza, ciudadanía, lugar de origen, religión, fe, embarazo, estado familiar, estado civil, orientación sexual, sexo, identidad de género, expresión de género, afiliación política, condición de veterano protegido, nivel socioeconómico, afiliación sindical, o la asociación real o percibida con una persona identificada por una o más de estas características, y cualquier otra base protegida por ley (cada una una “Característica Protegida”).

Si necesitas un ajuste razonable para completar tu aplicación, por favor contacta a tu reclutador. Reckitt está comprometida con la inclusión total de todas las personas calificadas.

Our Marketing Growth team runs the consumer programs that reach millions of shoppers — subscriptions, giveaways, surveys, and lifecycle campaigns across email, push, in-app, and landing pages. This role sits where marketing meets data, engineering and product. You'll write the queries that tell us whether a program actually worked, design the tests that answer questions we'd otherwise be guessing at, and translate between the marketing team and the engineers who build the surfaces we run on.

As a Marketing Growth Analytics & Operations Intern, you will play a critical role in measuring and improving the programs that drive our consumer business. A core focus will be writing the queries and building the reporting that tell us whether a program worked, and designing the tests that answer the questions we would otherwise be guessing at. In addition to analysis, you will work closely with Product and Engineering to translate marketing needs into clear requirements and to identify what we would need built to make new programs possible. This role is well suited to someone with a technical background who is drawn to the business and product side of the work, and who wants exposure to how marketing decisions actually get made.

Answer questions with data


Write your own SQL to pull campaign, cohort, and subscription performance.
Track the metrics that drive the business: DAU, NTM, LTV, CAC
Compare performance across time periods and segments, and flag the shifts that matter before anyone asks.
Take ownership of the dashboards behind our decisions, and use AI to find the answers hiding in them


Design and measure experiments


Help design A/B tests across channels — audience splits, variants, and success metrics defined before anything launches
Write the post-test analysis: what worked, what didn't, what we do differently next time
Own consumer surveys from request to results: define and query the audience, launch, monitor completion, report back what we learned, and optimize the process


Bridge marketing and engineering


Turn marketing needs into specs and tickets an engineer can act on 
Investigate when something breaks — trace an issue through dashboards and logs back to its source
QA new product features and surfaces, and help decide how marketing should be using them
Spot underused channels and product surfaces, and propose how marketing could leverage them


Automate And Improve How We Work


Use AI tools (Claude and similar) to build leverage into your own work — recurring reports, first-pass analyses, triage. If a task comes back every week, we'd rather you automate it

Own recurring operational queues and look for the pattern behind repeat problems instead of just clearing them

Skills & Competencies


Basic working knowledge of SQL.

description:
About the job

About Kueski

At Kueski, we're dedicated to improving the financial lives of people in Mexico. Since 2012, we've been the leading buy now, pay later (BNPL) and online consumer credit platform in Latin America, known for our innovative financial services. Our flagship product, Kueski Pay, provides seamless payment solutions for both online and in-store transactions, establishing itself as the preferred option for nearly 30% of Mexico's top e-commerce merchants. Notably, we were the first to introduce BNPL on Amazon Mexico.

We're a tech company with a culture geared toward innovation, collaboration, and impact, fostering a strong, diverse, and inclusive workplace. Our commitment to excellence and ethical business practices has earned us multiple industry recognitions. In 2024, we were named one of the World’s Top FinTech Companies by CNBC and recognized as one of the most ethical companies in Mexico by AMITAI. Additionally, we were certified as a Best Place to Work for LGBTQ+ Equality by HRC Equidad MX 2025 and ranked among the Best Companies for Female Talent by EFY.

Position

The Growth Team Lead is the owner of Kueski’s active customer growth across Kueski Pay and Kueski Cash. This PM IV-level role pairs senior product leadership with commercial ownership: sets and commits to active customer targets, and chairs a standing cross-functional Growth Team spanning Lending, Marketing, Branding, CX, Data, Account Management, and Risk.

The Growth Team Lead resolves trade-offs across these functions, prioritizes the growth levers that matter most, and builds the foundational infrastructure — lifecycle marketing, attribution, shared metrics — that determines whether every other growth initiative can succeed.

Key Responsibilities

Product Strategy & Commercial Ownership


Own the P&L outcome for Kueski’s active customer growth and report progress against targets to executive leadership.
Set and commit to active customer growth targets, then translate those targets into pillar-level OKRs owned by named cross-functional leads; paired with leading indicators the team can move within an experiment window.
Prioritize the core growth pillars, including pricing and acceptance, activation, repeat usage and habit formation, churn prediction, and reactivation.


Cross-Functional Growth Leadership


Resolve trade-offs between competing functional goals, such as portfolio growth versus customer or merchant experience.
Lead the cross-functional Growth Team spanning Lending, Marketing, Branding, CX, Data, Account Management, and Risk, driving weekly pillar standups and monthly growth reviews.
Partner with Engineering, Design, and Data to scope and sequence foundational and short-term growth product work, including activation, engagement, and retention features.


Experimentation & Growth Measurement


Direct the fix of foundational growth infrastructure — lifecycle marketing enablement, attribution, and the shared growth dashboard — as a prerequisite for reliable retention and lifecycle programs.


Executive Communication & Strategic Alignment


Build narratives that align cross-functional partners around growth strategy, progress, and results, and represent growth priorities in quarterly leadership reviews.


Experience


7+ years in product management, including ownership of cross-functional or multi-product initiatives at scale.
Proven track record owning a growth or lifecycle P&L, or equivalent commercial accountability, ideally in consumer fintech, or consumer lending business.
Experience leading a cross-functional team and resolving trade-offs among stakeholders with competing goals.
Working knowledge of lifecycle marketing and growth infrastructure (e.g., an ESP/CDP such as Braze, attribution, CMS).
Strong analytical and experimentation background, with the ability to define north-star and leading-indicator metrics and read them inside a test window.
Demonstrated success in influencing senior stakeholders, including CEO/CFO-level target-setting conversations.
Excellent storytelling communication; able to simplify complexity and inspire action across technical and business audiences.
Experience applying AI tools or automation to improve growth decision-making.
English and Spanish professional proficiency


Diversity & Inclusion

At Kueski we embrace diversity in all forms, systematically promote equity, and ensure everyone feels included with a sense of belonging. We are committed to the full inclusion of all qualified candidates. As part of this commitment, we will make efforts to ensure reasonable accommodations are made during the hiring process. If reasonable accommodation is needed, please let the Talent Acquisition team know.

description:
About the job

Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies - from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups - use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career.

At Stripe, our Mexico City office is a vibrant hub at the forefront of our mission to reshape the financial landscape for businesses worldwide. Our team prioritizes collaboration, innovation, and excellence. As a member of the Mexico City team, you'll be part of a mission-driven community dedicated to enhancing the global economy and increasing the GDP of the internet. We strive for excellence by creating with craft and beauty, while having fun and celebrating our successes together.

We cultivate a culture of collaboration, inclusivity and support where every team member’s voice matters. Our commitment shines through as we handle over a million support cases each year, empowering our users not just to solve problems but to achieve their goals.

About The Team

Stripe is investing in building out its Global Professional Services team to actively engage all customers from Fortune 100s to startups to help accelerate their adoption of Stripe capabilities. The team is responsible for ensuring that our customers deploy quickly with high quality integrations. It then partners closely with front line developers and technical leaders to ensure our customers continue to derive strategic value from Stripe and grow with us as our respective product portfolio expands. In addition, as we master the craft of deployment services, help build the asset and strategy that will enable us to scale through our partner ecosystem.

The Stripe Accelerate is a 3-month offering that unlocks access to a team of Stripe experts to help the user through every step of the implementation. This is included as part of Stripe solution, at no extra cost to our users. Accelerate Onboarding Managers provide prescriptive guidance and planning for the user’s onboarding journey. Onboarding Specialists provide product workshops, best practices, regular check-ins, and technical Q&A. This offering is targeted at Startup and SMB users.

A Few Key Features Of Accelerate Include


Specialized experts: Accelerate experts provide experience helping customers integrate Stripe technology in thousands of projects.
Project management consists of a kick off call, regular check-ins, email Q&A to help unblock your team.
Product workshops and training for fraud and dashboard



What you’ll do

The Onboarding Specialist is responsible for providing technical guidance to users during their onboarding journey with Stripe. They proactively address technical queries, troubleshoot issues, and provide solutions to ensure a seamless onboarding process. They work closely with users to understand their needs, offer guidance on best practices, and anticipate and address any potential technical challenges. The Onboarding Specialist collaborates with cross-functional teams, escalates issues as needed, and maintains accurate records of user interactions. Their goal is to provide exceptional customer service and ensure that users have a positive and successful onboarding experience with Stripe.

Responsibilities


Proactively providing technical guidance and support to users during their onboarding journey with Stripe.
Deliver pre-built technical workshops and kick off calls to users.
Provide light touch project management for ongoing Stripe implementations and timely escalate any delays with planned go-live dates.
Troubleshooting technical issues and providing timely solutions to ensure a smooth onboarding process.
Collaborating with cross-functional teams to address user queries and concerns.
Maintaining accurate records of user interactions, issues, and resolutions.
Anticipating and addressing potential technical challenges during the onboarding process. Proactively propose improvements.
Offering guidance on best practices, product features, and account setup to ensure user success.
Continuously updating knowledge of Stripe's products, features, and updates.
Escalating complex technical issues to appropriate teams for resolution.
Providing exceptional customer service to ensure a positive onboarding experience for users.
Contributing to the improvement of onboarding processes and documentation.



Who you are

We're looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Minimum Requirements


Advanced English proficiency- fluent in written and spoken.
2+ years of implementation consulting in API technologies or other complex technical environments.
Excellent problem-solving and troubleshooting skills.
Strong technical understanding of APIs and experience with SaaS solutions.
Comfortable talking about technical concepts, and explaining how Stripe works, both from a product features and API architecture perspective.
Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with an ability to effectively engage and influence various stakeholders.



Preferred Qualifications


Experience working with financial systems, online payments, or e-commerce platforms.
Experience collaborating with cross-functional teams in a fast-paced environment.
Experience delivering live technical training to users.
Comfortable with various code-level debugging & writing of code.



In-office expectations

Office-assigned Stripes in most of our locations are currently expected to spend at least 50% of the time in a given month in their local office or with users. This expectation may vary depending on role, team and location. For example, Stripes in Stripe Delivery Center roles in Mexico City, Mexico, Bengaluru, India, and Dublin, Ireland work 100% from the office. Also, some teams have greater in-office attendance requirements, to appropriately support our users and workflows, which the hiring manager will discuss. This approach helps strike a balance between bringing people together for in-person collaboration and learning from each other, while supporting flexibility when possible.

Pay and benefits

Stripe does not yet include pay ranges in job postings in every country. Stripe strongly values pay transparency and is working toward pay transparency globally.

We look forward to hearing from you.

At Stripe, we're looking for people with passion, grit, and integrity. You're encouraged to apply even if your experience doesn't precisely match the job description. Your skills and passion will stand out—and set you apart—especially if your career has taken some extraordinary twists and turns. At Stripe, we welcome diverse perspectives and people who think rigorously and aren't afraid to challenge assumptions. Join us.

Apply now

About the job

Descripción de la Empresa

félix es una marca mexicana de bebidas enfocada en productos naturales de alta calidad hechos en México. La empresa destaca por sus ingredientes limpios y elaborados sin endulzantes artificiales, apelando a consumidores que buscan opciones más saludables. félix valora la autenticidad, la producción local y un enfoque moderno en la innovación de bebidas. Quienes se integran al equipo se suman a una marca en crecimiento que prioriza la calidad, la transparencia y la confianza del cliente. Trabajar en félix ofrece la oportunidad de contribuir a la expansión de una línea de productos distintiva y orientada a la salud en el mercado mexicano.

title: Agente de Viajes desde casa
description:
About the job

Agente de Viajes desde casa (100% Home Office)




¿Te apasionan los viajes y buscas una oportunidad para generar ingresos con horarios flexibles?

Estamos buscando personas con actitud emprendedora que deseen desarrollarse como Agentes de Viajes Independientes, trabajando de forma remota bajo un atractivo esquema de comisiones.




No es necesario contar con experiencia previa en turismo. Te brindamos la capacitación y las herramientas necesarias para comenzar tu desarrollo profesional en la industria de los viajes.




¿Qué ofrecemos?

Modalidad 100% remota.

Horarios flexibles.

Capacitación y certificación como Agente de Viajes.

Mentoría y acompañamiento continuo.

Acceso a más de 140 proveedores nacionales e internacionales.

Plataformas profesionales para cotizar y reservar vuelos, hoteles, cruceros, parques temáticos, resorts y experiencias.

Comisiones competitivas pagadas en dólares.

Oportunidades de crecimiento de acuerdo con tu desempeño.

Potencial de ingresos

Esquema 100% por comisiones.

Ingresos estimados entre $20,000 y $30,000 MXN mensuales o más, dependiendo de tu dedicación y resultados.

Sin límite de ingresos.

Tu crecimiento dependerá de tu compromiso, constancia y desarrollo comercial.

Principales actividades

Asesorar a clientes en la planeación de sus viajes.

Cotizar y gestionar reservas de vuelos, hoteles, cruceros, resorts y experiencias.

Diseñar itinerarios personalizados.

Promover destinos turísticos, parques temáticos, conciertos y eventos deportivos.

Brindar seguimiento antes, durante y después del viaje.

Desarrollar y fidelizar tu propia cartera de clientes.

Perfil que buscamos

Buscamos personas que:

Disfruten las ventas y la atención al cliente.

Tengan interés por el turismo y los viajes.

Sean organizadas, responsables y proactivas.

Busquen una actividad independiente con flexibilidad de horarios.

Manejen herramientas digitales básicas.

No es indispensable contar con experiencia en turismo; nosotros te capacitamos desde el inicio.

Requisitos

Escolaridad mínima: Licenciatura concluida o trunca.

Edad: 27 a 65 años.

Facilidad de comunicación.

Gusto por las ventas y el servicio al cliente.

Acceso a internet y equipo de cómputo.

¿Por qué esta oportunidad?

Formarás parte de una industria con alta demanda y crecimiento constante, donde podrás desarrollar tu propia cartera de clientes, generar ingresos por comisiones y construir una actividad profesional con libertad para administrar tu tiempo.

Contarás con capacitación continua, herramientas profesionales y acompañamiento durante tu desarrollo para ayudarte a alcanzar tus objetivos.

Postúlate

Si deseas conocer más sobre esta oportunidad, postúlate por este medio.

Los candidatos seleccionados serán invitados a una sesión informativa por Zoom, donde conocerán el modelo de trabajo, el proceso de capacitación y los pasos para comenzar como Agente de Viajes desde casa

title: 🔥 Elite Ecommerce Growth Agency Looking For Google Ad Manager
description:
About the job

🔥🔥🔥We're an international ecommerce agency, and we're looking for an experienced Google Ad Manager to join our remote team! Knowing RUO peptides, telehealth is a BIG PLUS since most of our clients are in this niche. 




Your work will be reviewed by our CEO and Head of Google Ads who actually did Google Ads for 12 years before.




IDEAL APPLICANT:

✔️ High empathy toward clients, good communicator, problem-solving attitude (probably, the most important, sometimes we have tough situations with clients)

✔️ Being data-driven since we’ll conduct many data-driven testing to improve the results of the clients

✔️ Being organized since we have tight deadlines sometimes

✔️ Have experience with restricted niches such as RUO peptides, telehealth, vaping. 

✔️ Able to see an ecommerce business holistically because conversions are tightly connected to other parts of the business (offer-ads-email etc), ideally had his/her own business before or still have it

✔️ Minimum 5 years of experience with Google Ads

✔️ The applicant has min. 3-5 case studies we can also use in our sales.

✔️ The applicant is able to explain his work and even complex things in a simple way to us and the client.

✔️ Being an accountable and responsible person

✔️ A person eager to learn and grow in our team. The online marketing world changes fast.

✔️ Being available between 11am-7pm European Time on weekdays.

✔️ Fluent English speaker and writer. Have real-life English speaking experience with natives.

✔️ Can work as a subcontractor, we don’t have employees at the moment, everyone is a subcontractor.

✔️ It’s ok for the person if we pay based on work delivered for the first 3-6 months (hourly rate or a negotiated monthly salary), then later we can move towards a fix salary per month + bonuses.




PERKS:

🔥 We want to learn, so we travel a lot. The ideal applicant loves traveling, attending conferences and network. The company helps the new AM to go to conferences if the person works well (we buy the ticket, flight ticket etc) and we have an annual team meeting in Europe with people coming from 4 continents.

🔥 You can participate our training program personally with Daniel.

🔥 You can become a member of a great team of international people who push each other to become the best of ourselves.

🔥 Great opportunities for a promotion since we’re still a small team and growing fast.

🔥 You can work from wherever you want.

🔥 The work involves 3-5 meetings a week but apart from that, you’ll work mostly alone.




And what's the best thing about working with us?

We'll share the results, sales, and conversions of 7-8-figure e-commerce clients with you. You'll receive feedback and results of your work; while also being able to learn and improve.




DELIVERABLES:

👉 Building out the Google Ads strategy for max. 5 clients in the next months

👉 Keeping the avg. NPS of communication, overall satisfaction, results for her clients above 8

👉 Creating weekly reports to the clients and share it with them

👉 Managing the Google Ads projects for each client account (max. 3 campaigns per client by default)

👉 Projecting the profit and loss statement of each managed client project and meeting the targets every quarter (taught to you by us)

👉 Conducting Google Ads audits for our clients and potential new clients including keyword research

👉 Tracking installation for our clients and KPI setup

👉 Managing the creative people (copywriter, designer) when necessary

👉 Communicating with the clients, and their product research team via Slack, email, or Skype (expected response time within 12 hrs)

👉 Having 1 live call every week with every client if they want

👉 Helping our team members build the Google Ads workflows of the team, document new processes, checking new software tools we may use in the future.

👉 Attending internal meetings with the Budai team (monthly meeting + weekly account managers meeting)




Next Steps:

We will be sending you a test this Friday, on Aug 28th.

description:
About the job

Who We Are

Motive empowers the people who run physical operations with tools to make their work safer, more productive, and more profitable. For the first time ever, safety, operations and finance teams can manage their drivers, vehicles, equipment, and fleet related spend in a single system. Combined with industry leading AI, the Motive platform gives you complete visibility and control, and significantly reduces manual workloads by automating and simplifying tasks.

Motive serves nearly 100,000 customers – from Fortune 500 enterprises to small businesses – across a wide range of industries, including transportation and logistics, construction, energy, field service, manufacturing, agriculture, food and beverage, retail, and the public sector.

Visit gomotive.com to learn more.

About The Role

Being customer obsessed and data driven is what drives this role. We’re looking for individuals who can empathize with users, and work towards making their everyday lives easier. If you’re analytical, detail-oriented, and organized, but also excited to roll up your sleeves and get your hands dirty, you’d fit right in. The role will require rotational working hours to ensure smooth operational running of the 24/7/365 real-time set up, and collaboration with a global team. This role directly powers a critical live customer-facing product safety product, which forms the foundation for multiple other safety features. You would be the expert at risk identification, for all our customers using our safety products. You would also work closely with the Research & Development teams, to power our in-house Machine Learning and Artificial Intelligence models, by generating high quality training datasets. This requires an understanding of data requirements, data definitions, edge-cases, tooling and review processes. In addition to that, you would also work closely with the Product team to run proof of concepts and experiments, which guide the direction of our Safety product suite, particularly in the areas of risk identification, mitigation, and reduction. You would also contribute toward analyzing data to improve the user experience for our customers. You’ll work a regular five‑day schedule, including day, evening and/or overnight and weekend shifts as part of a rotation. Overnight (11pm - 7am for example) shifts include enhanced compensation where applicable.

What You'll Do


Review and analyze live videos captured by Motive's dashcam for risk identification, based on the known risk factors combined with the contextual knowledge which would vary from case to case.
Adhere to the established guidelines and protocols for annotation to ensure consistency and reliability of data.
Ensure timely delivery of accurate data as per SLAs.
Consistently strive to enhance the annotation procedures and play a role in shaping the team's best practices through active participation.
Exhibit flexibility and adaptability in taking on new responsibilities beyond the scope of the defined job description, showcasing a proactive and versatile approach to work.


What We're Looking For


Preferably, a Bachelors in Computer Science, IT, Management or related field.
Detail oriented and organized, with a growth mindset.
Thinks, designs and executes keeping customers at the center of the solution.
Interested in learning about the annotation landscape and application of AI/ML in the trucking industry.
Ability to work collaboratively, in a 24/7/365 set up, with strong context in between them.
The position requires working day, evening and overnight shifts and weekends, while maintaining a standard five-day work week overall.
Good communication skills, oral and written.
Ability to work on multiple projects and tools, and switch context in between them.


Creating a diverse and inclusive workplace is one of Motive's core values. We are an equal opportunity employer and welcome people of different backgrounds, experiences, abilities and perspectives. 

Please review our Candidate Privacy Notice here.

UK Candidate Privacy Notice here.

The applicant must be authorized to receive and access those commodities and technologies controlled under U.S. Export Administration Regulations. It is Motive's policy to require that employees be authorized to receive access to Motive products and technology. 

All job postings are for existing vacancies. Please note; some interviews or new-hire training sessions may be held in person at one of our global offices.

description:
About the job

Company Description

BLK Global Logistics designs and executes logistics and customs-brokerage solutions for the energy, industrial, and infrastructure sectors, helping clients move critical cargo across Mexico and the United States. We partner closely with our clients to grow the value of every relationship, through collaboration, problem-solving, and continuous improvement.

About the Role

Key Account Manager (Bilingual) — Strategic Accounts, Energy Sector. Full-time, on-site in Lerma, State of Mexico, with travel to the United States (2–3 visits per year).

You lead the relationship with strategic accounts that belong to a global corporate groups with entities in Mexico and the United States, and your mandate is to grow the value of those relationships. You inherit a mature portfolio from day one. Your variable compensation is tied to new business and its margin — not to existing billing — because the job is to cultivate and expand the account, not simply maintain it. You own the strategic relationship and its growth; day-to-day operational execution is handled by a dedicated operations team, which frees you to focus entirely on the customer and on new scope.

Responsibilities

Own the strategic relationship with high-value accounts and grow account value by identifying and closing new scope.
Design commercial offers and lead end-to-end RFQ (request for quotation) processes.
Read account-level P&L and make margin-based commercial decisions.
Coordinate across multiple entities of the global corporate group, aligning differing interests.
Build account plans and lead business reviews grounded in performance data.
Use AI tools for account research, meeting preparation, and offer/proposal drafting.

Travel to the United States (2–3 visits per year) to develop the relationship on both sides of the border.

Must-have qualifications

Fluent working use of AI in the sales workflow (account research, preparation, drafting).
Demonstrable experience in key account management or strategic sales within logistics, transportation, or supply chain.
Fluent English and Spanish at negotiation level, written and spoken, for client interactions and decision-making.

Preferred qualifications

Experience managing clients that are part of global corporate groups, coordinating across multiple entities with differing interests.
Solid understanding of international trade operations (customs, pedimentos, regimes, Incoterms).
Ability to design commercial offers and lead end-to-end RFQ processes.
Ability to interpret account-level P&L and make margin-based commercial decisions.
Willingness and ability to travel to the United States with valid or obtainable migration documentation.
Proficiency with CRM tools and data reporting. 
Bachelor's degree in Business, Logistics, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

description:
About the job

Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world's largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career.

Stripe was built with simplicity in mind. We strive to deliver frictionless experiences for all of our users, whether they are an Independent Business, Startup, SMB, or Enterprise, and our mission is to provide all Stripe Users with the best support experience possible. Today, Stripe handles over a million support cases per year and processes millions of internal transactions. We're going to achieve excellence by thinking of support in a novel, solution-oriented way, and viewing operations as an integral enabler of all of Stripe's growth.

About The Team

At Stripe, our Mexico City office is a vibrant hub at the forefront of our mission to reshape the financial landscape for businesses worldwide. Our team prioritizes collaboration, innovation, and excellence. As a member of the Mexico City team, you'll be part of a mission-driven community dedicated to enhancing the global economy and increasing the GDP of the internet. We strive for excellence by creating with craft and beauty, while having fun and celebrating our successes together.

We cultivate a culture of collaboration, inclusivity, and support where every team member's voice matters. Our commitment shines through as we handle over a million support cases each year, empowering our users not just to solve problems but to achieve their goals.

What you'll do

Responsibilities


Have the opportunity to join an operations team across Risk, Product Support, and Financial Crimes
Troubleshoot and solve complex problems
Analyze our processes and instigate changes to help scale our operations and improve user experience
Work closely with other Stripe teams across the globe
Gain unique insights into how thousands of businesses on Stripe scale and operate
Have an opportunity to learn how Stripe operates from the ground up and make a real impact on the future of the organization
Be a part of building a brand-new team and operational culture for Stripe



Who you are

We're looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Minimum Requirements


You are a recent graduate with less than 12 months of full-time working experience or a 2025 or 2026 graduate with full-time availability.
You have excellent English communication skills, both written and verbal.
You have a user-first mindset and are energized by the challenge of solving difficult problems.
You excel in analytical thinking and problem solving.
You enjoy learning about technical products and processes. You are an organized self-starter with a passion for finding solutions to our users' challenges.
You have a process-oriented mindset and ability to get things done.
You enjoy working in an in-office environment with strong cross-team collaboration and support.
You are able to prioritize and enjoy working in a quick-moving environment.
You are humble and have a proven track record for working well across teams and with external partners.



In-office expectations

Office-assigned Stripes in most of our locations are currently expected to spend at least 50% of the time in a given month in their local office or with users. This expectation may vary depending on role, team and location. For example, Stripes in Stripe Delivery Center roles in Mexico City, Mexico, Bengaluru, India, and Dublin, Ireland work 100% from the office. Also, some teams have greater in-office attendance requirements, to appropriately support our users and workflows, which the hiring manager will discuss. This approach helps strike a balance between bringing people together for in-person collaboration and learning from each other, while supporting flexibility when possible.

Pay and benefits

Stripe does not yet include pay ranges in job postings in every country. Stripe strongly values pay transparency and is working toward pay transparency globally.

We look forward to hearing from you.

At Stripe, we're looking for people with passion, grit, and integrity. You're encouraged to apply even if your experience doesn't precisely match the job description. Your skills and passion will stand out—and set you apart—especially if your career has taken some extraordinary twists and turns. At Stripe, we welcome diverse perspectives and people who think rigorously and aren't afraid to challenge assumptions. Join us.

Apply now

title: Consultor Comercial B2B
description:
About the job

 Acerca de Cari AI

Cari AI es una empresa de tecnología con 11 años de trayectoria especializada en la transformación del servicio al cliente mediante inteligencia artificial conversacional. Nuestra solución modular — comparable a piezas de Lego de alto valor — permite a grandes organizaciones automatizar, personalizar y escalar sus operaciones de atención al cliente con impacto financiero medible.




Operamos en Colombia y México (Y otros países a través de partners) con un modelo de venta B2B de ciclos largos (3 a 9 meses), tickets promedio deseados superiores a USD$160.000 y una base de clientes en sectores como retail, banca, telecomunicaciones, salud y servicios públicos.




Estamos en una etapa de crecimiento acelerado con un forecast de no más de 20 deals por trimestre, lo que exige consultores capaces de gestionar cuentas de alto valor con precisión quirúrgica, no volúmenes masivos de prospección.




2. Propósito del rol

El Consultor Comercial B2B de Cari AI es el arquitecto de relaciones con grandes cuentas. Su misión no es “vender” en el sentido transaccional del término: es diagnosticar problemas de negocio reales, orquestar equipos internos (Preventa, Proyectos, Arquitectura), construir business cases irrefutables y guiar al cliente a una decisión de inversión que le genere retorno medible.




Este cargo es estratégico. Interactúa con gerentes alrededor de toda la compañía. Deberá hablar el lenguaje de los números, entender el modelo de negocio del cliente y posicionarse como un asesor de confianza a largo plazo, no como un vendedor de funcionalidades.




3. Responsabilidades clave

3.1 Gestión del pipeline y forecast

Gestionar un portafolio de máximo 20 deals activos por trimestre, con ticket promedio superior a $600 millones COP, asegurando calidad sobre cantidad.

Mantener el CRM (Zoho) actualizado en tiempo real: etapa del negocio, probabilidad de cierre, próximos pasos y fecha estimada de cierre.

Construir y presentar el forecast mensual al director comercial con datos auditables, eliminando corazonadas y suposiciones.

Aplicar metodología MEDDIC (o similar) para calificar y descalificar oportunidades de manera certera, protegiendo las horas de Preventa y Proyectos, y en general de la compañía.




Competencias conductuales (Soft Skills)

Mentalidad de gestor de valor, no de vendedor: Entiende que el cliente no “compra”, invierte. Su enfoque es demostrar impacto financiero, no listar características.

Coachability (entrenabilidad): Humildad para recibir feedback, reconocer errores y actuar con rapidez para corregirlos. Ego bajo, ego de resultados alto.

Resiliencia y manejo del rechazo: Fortaleza emocional para mantener el ritmo en ciclos de venta largos con múltiples stakeholders y decisiones postergadas.

Disciplina operativa: Rigor para mantener el CRM actualizado, cumplir plazos internos y ejecutar el proceso sin depender de que alguien le recuerde los pasos.

Pensamiento estratégico: Capacidad para leer el contexto político del cliente (quién decide, quién influye, quién bloquea) y navegar comités de compra complejos.




Experiencia requerida

Experiencia mínima

5 a 10 años de experiencia total en roles comerciales B2B, de los cuales al menos 3 deben ser en venta de soluciones tecnológicas o servicios de alto valor.

Historial comprobable de cierre de negocios con tickets superiores a $200 millones COP (o equivalente en USD/MXN).

Experiencia gestionando ciclos de venta complejos con múltiples interlocutores: gerentes, directores y C-Level.




Experiencia deseable

Venta de soluciones SaaS, IA, automatización o contact center en Colombia y/o México.

Participación en procesos de licitación pública o privada (conocimiento de pliegos, anexos y cronogramas de adjudicación).

Experiencia en sectores de alto consumo de CX: banca, seguros, retail, telecomunicaciones, salud, utilities o gobierno.

Exposición a procesos de venta en múltiples países de Latinoamérica o cuentas corporativas transnacionales.

Haber liderado o participado en la construcción de SOWs y propuestas técnico-comerciales junto a equipos de Preventa o Arquitectura.




Formación académica

Título profesional requerido

Ingeniería industrial, Administración de empresas, Economía, Negocios internacionales, Ingeniería de sistemas o áreas afines.

Se valoran carreras con base cuantitativa: ingenierías, economía, matemáticas aplicadas.




Posgrado (altamente deseable, no excluyente)

MBA o Especialización en Gestión Comercial, Marketing B2B o Estrategia de Negocios.

Especialización en Finanzas o Inteligencia de Negocios. Refuerza la capacidad de construir business cases y hablar con CFOs.

Certificaciones comerciales valoradas: Challenger Sale, MEDDIC, HubSpot Sales, Salesforce Certified Sales Representative, LinkedIn Sales Insights.

Formación en IA aplicada o transformación digital. Cursos en Coursera, Google, AWS o similares que demuestren actualización tecnológica.

About the job

About LegitFit

LegitFit is an award-winning, all-in-one fitness management software platform serving gyms, yoga studios, pilates studios, CrossFit boxes, personal trainers, leisure centres, and hotels worldwide. Our platform powers bookings, memberships, classes, payments, client management, reporting, branded apps, and automated messaging - everything a fitness business needs to thrive.

Recognised as a Leader in Europe and EMEA by G2, Best Customer Support by Software Advice, and Best Ease of Use by Capterra, we are on a strong growth trajectory; with our customer base doubling year-over-year. Headquartered in Cork, Ireland, we operate as a remote-first team with a collaborative, high-ownership culture.




Role Overview

We’re seeking a proactive Onboarding Specialist for the Americas region to join our team. This role serves as a trusted advisor for LegitFit customers, championing their success through onboarding, relationship management, product adoption, and retention strategies. You’ll advocate for their needs internally, help them maximize LegitFit’s value, and coordinate with support, engineering, and product teams to improve customer outcomes. This role will work with Customers across the US, the wider Americas, and in some cases, customers in Europe




Key Responsibilities

About the job

Join our Team

Role Definition

The Service support specialist is a support role whose primary responsibility is to provide day to day support to end users. This is a Telecom/ICT Service Desk role, interacting with people of all levels in Ericsson (and their Customers) offices across the globe. The Service support specialist is responsible for tracking all assigned support requests through effective decision making and problem solving skills.

Receive, manage and record requests receiving either by phone, mail or Tickets.

Willing to work in shifts in a 24/7 support team

description:
About the job

PURPOSE

The Senior Service Specialist position is designed to be an integral part of the Operations Account Teams. This position focuses on providing level two support for customers by focusing on continuous improvement, efficiency and providing a consistent level of service for customers and support for Account teams. In addition, the Service Specialist II position works closely with the customer facing teams and our carrier partners to execute the day-to-day operation as a highly transactional service team. Advanced skills pertaining to standard processes and consistent customer communication.

Improve on time management, organization and planning skills.

title: Customer Support Specialist
skills: Gestionar el ciclo completo de las órdenes, desde la aceptación de la cotización hasta el cierre de la orden y su facturación.
Crear, procesar y monitorear órdenes de servicio en el sistema ERP, asegurando la precisión de la información y una ejecución oportuna.
Revisar las órdenes de compra de los clientes y verificar que se encuentren alineadas con las cotizaciones, precios y condiciones comerciales acordadas.
Coordinar con Service Engineers, Field Service, Planning, Warehouse, Logistics, Procurement y Finance para asegurar el cumplimiento eficiente de las órdenes.

Monitorear el avance de las órdenes, identificar posibles retrasos y coordinar acciones correctivas para minimizar el impacto en el cliente.
Asegurar que las solicitudes de los clientes sean atendidas de manera oportuna y profesional, de acuerdo con los niveles de servicio establecidos.
Apoyar las actividades de facturación, asegurando que la documentación de servicio esté completa, correcta y disponible dentro de los plazos requeridos.
Mantener actualizados y correctamente registrados los datos de clientes, órdenes y servicios en los sistemas internos.
Gestionar consultas, reclamos y situaciones escaladas de clientes, entregando soluciones oportunas o coordinando con las áreas internas correspondientes.
Colaborar con los equipos de Sales y Service para identificar oportunidades de mejora en los procesos y fortalecer la satisfacción del cliente.
Asegurar el cumplimiento de las políticas de la compañía, los estándares de calidad y los procedimientos de seguridad.
Formación profesional en Administración de Empresas, Ingeniería, Supply Chain, Logística o carreras relacionadas. Este requisito es deseable.
Entre 2 y 5 años de experiencia en Customer Support, Customer Service, Order Management, Service Coordination, Sales Support o posiciones similares.
Experiencia gestionando órdenes de clientes o de servicio, desde su ingreso hasta la entrega, cierre o facturación.
Experiencia trabajando con sistemas ERP.
Conocimiento de procesos de gestión de órdenes y buenas prácticas de atención al cliente.
Experiencia revisando órdenes de compra, cotizaciones, precios o documentación comercial.
Fuertes habilidades de organización y gestión del tiempo.
Alta atención al detalle y precisión en el manejo de información.
Capacidad para gestionar múltiples prioridades y cumplir plazos en un entorno dinámico.
Habilidades de resolución de problemas y pensamiento analítico.
Excelentes habilidades interpersonales, de comunicación y de gestión de stakeholders.
Actitud proactiva, adaptabilidad y un alto sentido de responsabilidad.
Nivel de inglés intermedio
description:
About the job

Cada día tenemos oportunidades de generar un impacto positivo en nuestros colegas, socios, clientes y en la sociedad. Juntos, desarrollamos las soluciones del futuro y liberamos todo el potencial de los recursos esenciales.

Confiamos en que las personas actúen con iniciativa y desafíen las formas tradicionales de pensar para desarrollar tecnologías líderes a nivel mundial, capaces de impulsar el progreso en áreas fundamentales como la energía, los alimentos, el agua y la industria marina.

Mientras contribuimos a construir un mundo más eficiente y con menos desperdicios, también desarrollamos nuestras carreras en un entorno abierto, colaborativo e innovador.

Sobre El Rol

Estamos buscando un/a Customer Support para incorporarse a nuestro equipo y brindar soporte a nuestras operaciones en México y Centroamérica.

En esta posición, serás responsable de gestionar el ciclo completo de las órdenes de servicio, desde la aceptación de la cotización y la creación de la orden hasta su ejecución, cierre y facturación. Trabajarás en estrecha colaboración con clientes y diferentes áreas internas para asegurar que las órdenes sean procesadas correctamente, ejecutadas dentro de los plazos establecidos y gestionadas de acuerdo con nuestros niveles de servicio.

Esta posición combina atención al cliente, gestión de órdenes, coordinación operativa y soporte al proceso de facturación. Es una excelente oportunidad para una persona que disfrute trabajar en un entorno dinámico, administrar múltiples prioridades y contribuir directamente a la satisfacción del cliente y a los resultados del negocio.

Principales Responsabilidades


Gestionar el ciclo completo de las órdenes, desde la aceptación de la cotización hasta el cierre de la orden y su facturación.
Crear, procesar y monitorear órdenes de servicio en el sistema ERP, asegurando la precisión de la información y una ejecución oportuna.
Revisar las órdenes de compra de los clientes y verificar que se encuentren alineadas con las cotizaciones, precios y condiciones comerciales acordadas.
Coordinar con Service Engineers, Field Service, Planning, Warehouse, Logistics, Procurement y Finance para asegurar el cumplimiento eficiente de las órdenes.
Mantener una comunicación proactiva con los clientes sobre el estado de sus órdenes, programación de servicios, fechas de entrega y actualizaciones relevantes.
Monitorear el avance de las órdenes, identificar posibles retrasos y coordinar acciones correctivas para minimizar el impacto en el cliente.
Asegurar que las solicitudes de los clientes sean atendidas de manera oportuna y profesional, de acuerdo con los niveles de servicio establecidos.
Apoyar las actividades de facturación, asegurando que la documentación de servicio esté completa, correcta y disponible dentro de los plazos requeridos.
Mantener actualizados y correctamente registrados los datos de clientes, órdenes y servicios en los sistemas internos.
Gestionar consultas, reclamos y situaciones escaladas de clientes, entregando soluciones oportunas o coordinando con las áreas internas correspondientes.
Colaborar con los equipos de Sales y Service para identificar oportunidades de mejora en los procesos y fortalecer la satisfacción del cliente.
Asegurar el cumplimiento de las políticas de la compañía, los estándares de calidad y los procedimientos de seguridad.


Requisitos


Formación profesional en Administración de Empresas, Ingeniería, Supply Chain, Logística o carreras relacionadas. Este requisito es deseable.
Entre 2 y 5 años de experiencia en Customer Support, Customer Service, Order Management, Service Coordination, Sales Support o posiciones similares.
Experiencia gestionando órdenes de clientes o de servicio, desde su ingreso hasta la entrega, cierre o facturación.
Experiencia trabajando con sistemas ERP.
Conocimiento de procesos de gestión de órdenes y buenas prácticas de atención al cliente.
Experiencia revisando órdenes de compra, cotizaciones, precios o documentación comercial.
Fuertes habilidades de organización y gestión del tiempo.
Alta atención al detalle y precisión en el manejo de información.
Capacidad para gestionar múltiples prioridades y cumplir plazos en un entorno dinámico.
Habilidades de resolución de problemas y pensamiento analítico.
Excelentes habilidades interpersonales, de comunicación y de gestión de stakeholders.
Actitud proactiva, adaptabilidad y un alto sentido de responsabilidad.
Nivel de inglés intermedio


Nos preocupamos por la diversidad, la inclusión y la equidad en nuestros procesos de selección. También creemos que las características conductuales pueden entregar información relevante sobre el ajuste de una persona a un determinado rol.

Para ayudarnos en este proceso, utilizamos las evaluaciones de Pymetrics. Al momento de postular, recibirás una invitación para completar los juegos de evaluación.

description:
About the job

About Vestacy

Vestacy is a standalone company (carved out from Reckitt) with a clear purpose: to transform houses into homes. We’re home to some of the world’s most trusted brands (Air Wick, Resolve, Brasso, Calgon, Cillit Bang, and Mortein) helping millions of people care for the spaces they live in every day.

Backed by Advent, a leading global private equity firm, we have the freedom to think big and move fast. With over 3,000 colleagues across 20+ countries, we see every person as a Founder, empowered to make bold decisions and shape what’s next.




About the role

To ensure seamless end-to-end supply chain execution with distributors, manufacturing sites, and internal stakeholders, and driving strong OTIF performance. The role is also responsible for maintaining product availability, optimizing service levels, supporting supply chain transitions, and contributing to operational excellence and business growth across emerging markets within the Global Expansion Unit (GEU).




Your responsibilities




Customer Service & Order Management

Manage customer orders from receipt through fulfillment, ensuring timely processing and execution.
Monitor order status, product availability, and shipment performance, proactively communicating updates to distributors and stakeholders.
Support the achievement of customer service targets and OTIF performance objectives.
Coordinate resolution of order-related issues, shortages, delays, and service disruptions.
Ensure compliance with service agreements, ordering policies, and operational procedures.




Demand & Sales Planning

Develop and maintain demand forecasts using historical sales, market intelligence, and customer inputs.
Collaborate with commercial teams and distributors to improve forecast accuracy and demand visibility.
Monitor forecast performance indicators, including Forecast Accuracy, BIAS, and service-related KPIs.
Identify demand trends, risks, and opportunities, proposing mitigation or improvement actions.
Support monthly demand review (IBP) processes.




Logistics Coordination

Coordinate shipment execution and logistics activities to ensure product availability and timely deliveries.
Work closely with manufacturing sites, distribution partners, and logistics providers to manage supply constraints and transportation issues.
Monitor inventory levels and support actions to optimize working capital while maintaining service levels.
Assist in managing inventory replenishment and supply allocation activities.
Support implementation of logistics and supply chain improvement initiatives.




Performance & Analytics

Monitor and report key Supply Chain KPIs, including OTIF, Service Level, Inventory, Forecast Accuracy, and Order Fulfillment metrics.
Perform root cause analysis for service failures, forecast deviations, inventory issues, and operational disruptions.
Generate reports and dashboards to support operational and management decision-making.
Identify continuous improvement opportunities to enhance efficiency, customer satisfaction, and supply chain performance.
Ensure data accuracy across planning, customer service, and ERP systems.




Stakeholder Management

Act as a key operational liaison between distributors, commercial teams, manufacturing sites, logistics providers, and planning functions.
Build collaborative relationships with internal and external stakeholders to support supply chain objectives.
Escalate risks and operational issues appropriately while proposing viable solutions.
Contribute to a culture of ownership, accountability, and continuous improvement across the GEU organization.




The experience we are looking for

Bachelor’s degree in Logistics, Engineering or Business Administration
Desirable professional certifications in Supply Chain Management, preferably in Integrated Business Planning (IBP) methodologies and processes.
Fluency in English & Spanish, written and spoken
+2 years of work experience in Logistics and Supply Chain Operations, as well as key performance indicators such as PFR, OTIF, BIAS, among others.
Nice to have: D365 knowledge.
Strong MS Office skills
Ability to coordinate processes across multiple functions.
Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
Strong organizational skills and attention to detail, with the ability to manage multiple priorities.
Proactive problem-solving, with the ability to identify and escalate risks.
Analytical skills to assess supply, inventory, and service-related issues.




Office location: Corporativo Miyana - Polanco, CDMX (hybrid model set-up)




Equality

We believe the best teams are built like great homes: on strong foundations and room to grow. That’s why we hire for potential as well as experience. If you resonate with our purpose, we encourage you to apply, even if you don’t tick every box. We’re committed to equal opportunity for all, regardless of age, ability, background, identity, or any other characteristic protected by law. Together, we create a space where everyone can thrive.

About The Team/role

This role will translate campaign briefs and business objectives into actionable digital media plans, working closely with Channel Managers, Marketing teams, Creative teams, Analytics and our media agency.

You will be responsible for ensuring campaigns are properly planned, implemented, monitored and optimized, while turning campaign performance into clear insights and learnings that can improve future media decisions.

We are looking for someone who combines strong digital media fundamentals, is curious about integrated media planning, with analytical thinking, attention to detail and curiosity about how media contributes to marketing and business outcomes.

In this role, you'll be...

Digital Media Planning


Translate campaign briefs and marketing objectives into actionable digital media plans.
Support the development of audience, channel, format and investment recommendations based on campaign objectives.

Integrate relevant business, market, audience and historical campaign learnings into media recommendations.
Ensure digital media planning is connected with the broader integrated campaign and other relevant media channels.

Campaign Monitoring & Optimization

Identify performance opportunities and work with Channel Managers and media agencies to implement optimizations.
Evaluate performance across audiences, placements, formats, creatives and other relevant media variables.
Escalate performance deviations, implementation issues or opportunities that require strategic decisions.
Support testing initiatives across audiences, creatives, formats and media tactics.



Measurement & Insights


Track campaign performance against agreed media and marketing KPIs.
Analyze results to understand what worked, what did not and why.
Go beyond media delivery metrics to identify potential connections between media performance and marketing or business outcomes.
Translate campaign results into clear insights and actionable recommendations.
Develop post-campaign analyses and consolidate learnings that can improve future campaigns.
Share relevant learnings across campaigns, markets and business units.



We're eager to be in touch because you have...


3–5 years of experience in digital media planning, media agencies, or similar roles.
Hands on understanding of major digital media platforms such as Meta, Google Ads, YouTube, TikTok and programmatic media.
Experience developing and executing digital media plans across different campaign objectives.
Strong understanding of digital media metrics including Reach, Frequency, CPM, CPC, CTR, VTR, CPA and conversion metrics.
Ability to analyze campaign performance and translate data into insights and recommendations.
Experience working with campaign budgets, investment pacing and media performance reporting.
Strong attention to detail and ability to manage multiple campaigns and stakeholders simultaneously.
Strong communication and presentation skills.
Comfortable working with Excel/Google Sheets and media reporting or visualization tools.
Ability to work in a fast paced, collaborative and constantly evolving environment.
English proficiency sufficient to collaborate with regional and global teams.

Experience working across CPG,Tech, Fintech, Streaming, DTC verticals

Ability to utilize Company-issued and approved Artificial Intelligence (AI) tools to support productivity, efficiency, and quality of work, while maintaining accountability for all AI-generated outputs

Why Signant Health?

At Signant Health, your work has real impact. Everything we build, support, and deliver helps advance clinical research and bring new treatments to patients faster — improving lives around the world. Our teams combine science, technology, and operational expertise to solve complex clinical trial challenges, and every role contributes to that mission.

We offer a collaborative, global environment where you can grow your career while working alongside experts across clinical, technology, data, and operations, with opportunities to learn, take ownership, and drive meaningful innovation — not just maintain the status quo.

You own Product & Lifecycle Growth marketing for Everand and Fable, end to end. Everand is our audiobook and ebook subscription product; Fable is our book-tracking and discovery community. description:
About the job

📍 Ubicación base: Monterrey, Nuevo León

🌎 Cobertura: Nacional

🏢 Empresa: Bramex Controles, S.A. de C.V.




En Bramex Controles estamos desarrollando una nueva división de negocios especializada en soluciones de refrigeración para transporte.

Buscamos a un profesional con experiencia comercial en este mercado que asuma el reto de introducir nuestra oferta, desarrollar clientes y construir progresivamente la estructura comercial de la división a nivel nacional.




EL RETO

Construir una división comercial desde su etapa inicial y convertirse, conforme avance el negocio, en su futuro líder nacional.




OBJETIVO DEL PUESTO

Desarrollar el mercado nacional de refrigeración para transporte mediante la prospección, apertura y atención de distribuidores, carroceros, talleres especializados, flotillas, agencias y usuarios finales.

Durante la primera etapa, el Coordinador Nacional será responsable directamente de las actividades comerciales. Conforme la división alcance los objetivos establecidos, participará en el diseño, contratación y liderazgo de la futura estructura de ventas.




PRINCIPALES RESPONSABILIDADES

• Diseñar y ejecutar el plan comercial nacional de la división.

• Identificar y desarrollar distribuidores, carroceros, instaladores y centros de servicio.

• Prospectar flotillas, empresas de logística, transportistas y usuarios finales.

• Realizar visitas comerciales y presentaciones técnicas en diferentes regiones del país.

• Detectar oportunidades y necesidades del mercado.

• Preparar propuestas comerciales y dar seguimiento a las cotizaciones hasta el cierre.

• Desarrollar relaciones comerciales de largo plazo con clientes y aliados estratégicos.

• Coordinar demostraciones, pruebas de producto y proyectos especiales.

• Analizar precios, productos y estrategias de la competencia.

• Elaborar pronósticos, presupuestos y reportes de ventas.

• Coordinarse con las áreas de ingeniería, servicio, operaciones, administración y logística.

• Asegurar el cumplimiento de los objetivos de ventas, rentabilidad, margen y cobranza.

• Proponer la estructura comercial necesaria conforme crezca la división.




PERFIL REQUERIDO

• Experiencia mínima de cuatro años en ventas técnicas B2B.

• Experiencia comprobable en refrigeración para transporte, carrocerías, vehículos comerciales, flotillas o sectores relacionados.

• Conocimiento del mercado nacional de transporte frigorífico.

• Relación comercial con distribuidores, carroceros, talleres, flotillas o empresas transportistas.

• Capacidad para desarrollar una unidad de negocio desde su etapa inicial.

• Disponibilidad para viajar frecuentemente dentro de México.

• Licencia de conducir vigente.

• Experiencia en el manejo de CRM, indicadores, presupuestos y pronósticos comerciales.

• Enfoque en resultados, rentabilidad y desarrollo de relaciones comerciales.




EXPERIENCIA QUE VALORAMOS ESPECIALMENTE

• Experiencia previa en empresas como Thermo King, Carrier Transicold, FB Transport, Friport o compañías relacionadas con refrigeración móvil.

• Cartera activa de clientes y contactos dentro del sector.

• Conocimientos técnicos de equipos de refrigeración para transporte.

• Experiencia en el desarrollo de distribuidores o canales comerciales.

• Inglés intermedio o avanzado.




COMPETENCIAS CLAVE

✓ Visión comercial y estratégica.

✓ Prospección y apertura de mercado.

✓ Negociación y cierre de ventas.

✓ Autonomía y capacidad de ejecución.

✓ Organización y seguimiento.

✓ Comunicación efectiva.

✓ Mentalidad emprendedora.

✓ Capacidad para construir y posteriormente liderar equipos.




OFRECEMOS

• Sueldo competitivo de acuerdo con la experiencia y los resultados comprobables.

• Esquema atractivo de comisiones y bonos por cumplimiento.

• Prestaciones de ley.

• Viáticos y herramientas de trabajo.

• Capacitación técnica y comercial.

• Oportunidad de desarrollar una nueva división con cobertura nacional.

• Plan de crecimiento hacia la Gerencia Nacional de la División, sujeto al desarrollo del negocio y a la formación de la estructura comercial.




¿A QUIÉN ESTAMOS BUSCANDO?

Buscamos a una persona que no solo quiera ocupar una posición, sino construir un proyecto comercial desde su etapa inicial y convertirse en el futuro líder nacional de la división.




POSTULACIÓN

Si cumples con el perfil y te interesa participar en este desafío, postúlate a través de LinkedIn y comparte tu CV, indicando tu experiencia en refrigeración para transporte, flotillas, carroceros o sectores relacionados.

Correo: rh@bramexcontroles.com.mx / guirau@bramexcontroles.com.mx




BRAMEX CONTROLES
